terms.comment: Our description for a code review. recōgnitiō, recōgnitiōnis f. — examination or review; cōdicis is the genitive of cōdex. The computing phrase is not presented as an independently attested standard. Use ordinary Latin case syntax to make the relationship between technical nouns explicit: recōgnitiō cōdicis, cursus ēlabōrātiōnis. The grammaticality of a phrase does not establish that it is idiomatic or widely used technical Latin; our new computing phrases remain labelled as working formations. Preserve exact commands, filenames, branch names and protocol tokens where translation would alter their identity.

recognitio.html: Lewis’s Elementary Latin Dictionary explicitly gives re-cōgnitiō.
